info.title: Comet Creator Publishing API
info.description: Server-to-server page authoring, creator media and publication events. Contact Comet for your integration origin, app credential, onboarding method and creator grant. Content versions 1 and 2 use the same version 1 API response envelope.

servers.description: Replace the placeholder with the origin provisioned for your integration.

put.description: Requires creator:bind. No request body is needed. Does not provision a grant or create a global creator identity.

get.summary: Discover current operations and content versions
get.description: Requires page:read or product:read, seller:read or order:read. May be called before binding. Use the returned grant, content descriptors and optional feature metadata.
Requires page:read. Requires active binding. IDs sort lexicographically, not chronologically. Start a fresh listing to discover concurrent insertions before a cursor.

parameters.description: Exclusive page ID cursor; use the prior nextCursor.

put.summary: Save a draft with version checks

delete.summary: Delete a page using exact reviewed versions
delete.description: Requires page:edit and, when expectedActiveRevision is nonnull, page:publish. Comet compares all three expected values with current state, so a false null cannot bypass publish authority. Retains a tombstone/history, clears the active publication, increments publicationVersion and emits page.deleted. Deleted pages disappear from author/public reads and page lists. Uploaded media and workspace are retained; no restore endpoint. Retry an unknown outcome with the identical key and body.
delete.x-required-capability: page:edit; additionally page:publish when expectedActiveRevision is nonnull

get.summary: Read an exact saved draft preview
get.description: Requires page:read. Rejects stale versions. Returns content and digest, not an HTML preview, public URL or credential.

post.description: Requires page:publish. Requires exact draft, active revision, publication version and digest. Publication readiness is enforced. Hosting registration is separate; reread GET page for publicUrl.

201.description: Successful operation. POST operations use HTTP 201, including idempotent retries.

post.description: Requires page:publish. Retains immutable history and increments publicationVersion. Digest is not required.

get.description: Requires page:read. Only the current active revision is readable here. This authenticated route does not provide public hosting or arbitrary history access.

get.summary: Poll durable lifecycle and publication events
get.description: Requires events:read. Returns a raw array, ascending realm-local sequence. Persist event IDs and cursor with consumer updates. No server acknowledgement endpoint. Separate event-reader grant supports terminal lifecycle reads while a realm is inactive.

Requires page:read and configured media. Only ready assets in the current verified binding are returned, newest ready timestamp first with descending ID as tiebreaker. Does not browse legacy organization-wide media.

schema.description: Opaque ready-time/upload-ID cursor. Use the exact nextCursor; server also validates its timestamp.

post.summary: Upload a creator image or video
post.description: Requires page:edit and configured media. JSON proxy upload: JPEG/PNG/WebP <=5 MiB; MP4/WebM <=20 MiB decoded. Only this route permits 28 MiB JSON. Preserve original key and bytes after unknown outcomes. UPLOAD_IN_PROGRESS means retry the same command after the active lease (60 seconds image / 150 seconds video). Current authority is checked again before finalization and replay. Cancellation cannot guarantee rollback of provider upload.

CometAppKey.name: x-api-key
CometAppKey.description: Server-held IAM APP_CLIENT API key with an explicit scoped grant. JWT/Authorization headers are rejected.

GrantGeneration.name: x-grant-generation
GrantGeneration.description: Current operator-provisioned grant generation; numeric value must be a nonnegative safe integer.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Reuse the exact key and payload after an ambiguous write. Scoped to principal, realm, operation and page; current authority is rechecked.

Content.description: Versioned content, bounded to 256 KiB. Use capability discovery. Semantic URL, markup, identity-uniqueness, UTF-16 length, depth and publication readiness checks remain authoritative on the server.

Error.description: Application error envelope. Ingress/body-parser failures may use a different envelope.

name.description: Trimmed, nonblank management name, limited to 120 UTF-16 code units.

ContentV2.description: Creator Publishing v2 content. Follow the capabilities of the current environment and validate publication readiness.

publicUrl.description: Current canonical HTTPS URL, or null when no eligible public route/publication exists. Only GET page returns this field; reread after mutations.

jsonSchema.description: Available on v2; structural JSON Schema with semantic checks enforced separately.

ContentDescriptor.description: Extensible discovery metadata, including limits, field descriptors or JSON Schema, and publication requirements. Do not treat v1 field descriptors as JSON Schema.

eventType.description: Examples: creator.bound, page.published, page.unpublished, authoring-grant.revoked, creator.suspended, creator.reactivated, page.route-renamed. Also page.deleted for durable page tombstones.

MediaCapabilities.description: Optional capability for compatibility with earlier services. maxBytes is the decoded image bound. maxVideoBytes is additive: clients must not offer video without the advertised video bound and MIME type. upload requires configured media and current page:edit.

fileName.description: Nonblank filename, at most 180 Unicode code points; no path separators or control characters.

dataBase64.description: Canonical base64, no data: prefix. Server checks canonical padding bits, decoded size and MIME/container match. 5 MiB images / 20 MiB videos; HTTP JSON body ceiling 28 MiB.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid app credential, or unsupported Authorization header.

403.description: Current grant, creator or realm authority does not allow this operation.

404.description: Scoped resource is absent or unavailable.

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT, PREVIEW_CONFLICT, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, BINDING_CONFLICT or UPLOAD_IN_PROGRESS (retry the same media command after its active lease). Media deletion in progress may return DELETE_IN_PROGRESS.

413.description: Request exceeds the route limit: 256 KiB normally, 28 MiB JSON for POST media; decoded media limit is 5 MiB for images and 20 MiB for videos. Ingress parser failures may use a different envelope.

422.description: CONTENT_NOT_READY: visible content is not ready for publication.

503.description: FEATURE_DISABLED, AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE or MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE (unconfigured media or provider failure).
